# Town of Weathersfield municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 25; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Weathersfield, Selectboard page (weathersfieldvt.org): lists the current board -- Rika Henderson (Chair, term to 2029), Dave Fuller (Vice Chair, to 2027), deForest Bearse (to 2028), Zach Van Valkenburgh (to 2027), and Joseph Bublat (to 2028)

Town of Weathersfield, '3/3/26 Town Voting Results' -- the official March 3, 2026 ballot with handwritten tallies, posted on the town's Voting Results page: Henderson was re-elected to a three-year term (543 votes) and Bublat elected to a two-year term (471) on March 3, 2026

Town of Weathersfield, FY2024-2025 Town Report, 'Town of Weathersfield, Vermont Elected Officials' list (as of December 31, 2025): the December 2025 roster -- Michael Todd, Henderson, Kelly O'Brien, Bearse, Nathan McNaughton -- is what the June 2026 Secretary of State directory carries (stale). Fuller and Van Valkenburgh now sit in the seats the report gave Todd and O'Brien (both expiring 2027); the succession mechanism is unpublished and the town's current page governs (disclosed on #163)
Town of Weathersfield, FY2024-2025 Town Report, 'Town of Weathersfield, Vermont Elected Officials' list (as of December 31, 2025): lists Flo-Ann Dango as Town Clerk, three-year term to 2027
Town of Weathersfield, Town Clerk page: names Flo-Ann Dango as Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Flo-Ann Dango as Weathersfield's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Flo-Ann Dango as Weathersfield's Town Clerk

Town of Weathersfield, FY2024-2025 Town Report, 'Town of Weathersfield, Vermont Elected Officials' list (as of December 31, 2025): lists Steven A. Hier as Town Treasurer, three-year term to 2027. He is also a Trustee of Public Funds and a Justice of the Peace; one person record carries all three memberships
Town of Weathersfield, Finance page: names Steven Hier as Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Steven Hier as Weathersfield's Town Treasurer

Town of Weathersfield, '3/3/26 Town Voting Results' -- the official March 3, 2026 ballot with handwritten tallies, posted on the town's Voting Results page: Sean Whalen was elected Moderator (one-year term) on March 3, 2026 with 610 votes. The FY2025 report shows he held the office as a write-in winner, and he signed the February 28, 2026 annual meeting minutes as Moderator

Town of Weathersfield, '3/3/26 Town Voting Results' -- the official March 3, 2026 ballot with handwritten tallies, posted on the town's Voting Results page: both vacant seats stood in 2026 as write-in races; the handwritten write-in names on the tally are not legibly readable, so those winners are stragglers, not seated

sources.note: Town of Weathersfield, FY2024-2025 Town Report, 'Town of Weathersfield, Vermont Elected Officials' list (as of December 31, 2025): lists Steven A. Hier (to 2027), Rick Bates (to 2028), and David (Hank) Ainley, appointed to a vacancy ('appt. 3yr./1yr. rem.')

Town of Weathersfield, '3/3/26 Town Voting Results' -- the official March 3, 2026 ballot with handwritten tallies, posted on the town's Voting Results page: Ainley was then ELECTED to a three-year term on March 3, 2026 (568 votes)

Town of Weathersfield, FY2024-2025 Town Report, 'Town of Weathersfield, Vermont Elected Officials' list (as of December 31, 2025): lists five commissioners on five-year terms -- Michael Stankevich (to 2029), Julia Lloyd Wright (to 2030), Ashley Esty (to 2027), Robert Holtorf (to 2028), and Ken Blum (to 2026)

Town of Weathersfield, '3/3/26 Town Voting Results' -- the official March 3, 2026 ballot with handwritten tallies, posted on the town's Voting Results page: Blum was re-elected March 3, 2026 (612 votes). Stankevich and Lloyd Wright are also Justices of the Peace; one record each carries both memberships

Town of Weathersfield, FY2024-2025 Town Report, 'Town of Weathersfield, Vermont Elected Officials' list (as of December 31, 2025): lists Anne Parent (to 2027), John Waite (to 2027), Alicia Jenks (to 2027 -- a write-in winner NAMED in the town's own officials list), and Rick Bates (to 2028); Mavis Shand's seat expired in 2026. Bates is also a Trustee of Public Funds; one record carries both

Town of Weathersfield, '3/3/26 Town Voting Results' -- the official March 3, 2026 ballot with handwritten tallies, posted on the town's Voting Results page: the 2026 ballot prints 'MAVIS SHAND ELLINGWOOD' and the tally elects her (611 votes) -- the same person as the report's Mavis Shand; the ballot form governs her name

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Weathersfield justices of the peace: John Arrison, Andrea Murray, Joseph Bublat, Michael J. Stankevich, James Cahill, Steven Hier, Julia Lloyd-Wright, August Murray, Annemarie Christensen, and Elaine Dunham

Town of Weathersfield, FY2024-2025 Town Report, 'Town of Weathersfield, Vermont Elected Officials' list (as of December 31, 2025): the town's own justice list concurs on the ten names (in the variants 'Andrea DeLuna-Murray,' 'Annmarie Christensen,' 'Steve Hier') and records Elaine Dunham as RESIGNED -- only the nine surviving winners are seated (departed-winner pattern)

jp_election.name: Town of Weathersfield Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): certifies the ten winners of Weathersfield's November 5, 2024 justice of the peace election (vote for ten): John Arrison, Andrea Murray, Joseph Bublat, Michael J. Stankevich, James Cahill, Steven Hier, Julia Lloyd-Wright, August Murray, Annemarie Christensen, and Elaine Dunham. The town's FY2025 report records Dunham as resigned, so she is recorded as a winner who no longer holds the seat and is not seated; the winners list holds the nine survivors
